name: Toolbar widgets help
description: Help mode entries for Toolbar widgets (help@1): the Attach widget menu, the Widgets tab and the widget dialog.
author: Brett

entries.title: Toolbar widgets
entries.text: Every widget on this toolbar: switch one off to hide it, the arrows move it, the gear sets its size, what it shows and its shape, the cross detaches it. Attach a widget puts another one on.

entries.title: Attach widget…
entries.text: Right-click or long-press any toolbar to put a widget on it (clock, status, counter, search bar…), banner style, at its start or end.

entries.title: Detach
entries.text: Takes the widget off this toolbar. One the toolbar or a plugin put there is hidden instead and can be switched back on.
